integrity: Proof is self-contained conditional on elementary Fourier orthogonality and binomial estimates. Finite checker outputs are auxiliary and do not substitute for the uniform asymptotic argument.
scientific_limitations: The Poisson-kernel annealed covariance is evaluated for integer expanding circle maps with switching probability varying across observation horizons. The staircase and crossover are triangular-array statements, not a fixed-kernel mixing theorem or a universal analytic-observable assertion. Independent mathematical validation is not asserted.
title: A rare-switching staircase and logarithmic transition windows in analytic correlations of random expanding circle maps
